package.name: auv_simulation
package.description: Simulation Environment (Software Head, item 4): a Gazebo (gz-sim / Harmonic) world containing a neutrally-buoyant AUV model, plus the ros_gz_bridge configuration that exposes it to ROS 2 as /model/auv/cmd_vel (in) and /model/auv/odometry (out). Contains no ROS 2 nodes of its own -- auv_vehicle's GazeboVehicleAdapter is the node-side consumer of the topics this package bridges.
